title: At-grade junctions between numbered roads
description: A candidate set with an upper bound on it, not a programme. Finding where two numbered roads cross is geometry; deciding which crossing wants a roundabout rather than signals, grade separation or nothing at all is engineering this repository cannot do. The traffic split is what turns the count into something actionable. Already-converted junctions do not appear at all, because a roundabout is mapped as its own loop and the roads then touch it rather than each other.

distinct.description: After clustering: one junction mapped as several nodes is one junction.

alreadyRoundabout.description: Small by construction — a converted junction usually stops being an intersection at all.

onMeasuredTraffic.description: The subset on roads above the noise directive's reporting threshold. The actionable part.
